57417316.name: Octatetraynyl radical
57417316.description: Octatetraynyl radical is an organic free radical with eight carbon atoms linked in a linear chain with alternating single bonds and triple bonds .

57461988.name: Americium dioxide
57461988.description: Americium dioxide is a black compound of americium. In the solid state, AmO2 adopts a fluorite structure . It is used as a source of alpha particles.

57478628.name: Isobuscaline
57478628.description: Isobuscaline , also known as 4-isobutoxy-3,5-dimethoxyphenethylamine, is a psychedelic drug of the phenethylamine and scaline families related to mescaline.

57517924.name: Coutaric acid
57517924.description: Coutaric acid is a hydroxycinnamoyltartaric acid found in wine, pomace and grape. It is an ester formed from coumaric acid and tartaric acid.

58216164.name: 3-Fluoromethamphetamine
58216164.description: 3-Fluoromethamphetamine is a stimulant drug related to methamphetamine and 3-fluoroamphetamine. It has been sold online as a designer drug.

59027940.name: SCHEMBL5334361
59027940.description: SCHEMBL5334361 is a drug which acts as an agonist at the 5-HT2 family of serotonin receptors, and was developed for the treatment of glaucoma.

71717732.name: M320 (opioid)
71717732.description: M320 is an extremely potent and long acting opioid.

85879908.name: JWH-184
85879908.description: JWH-184 is a synthetic cannabinoid receptor ligand from the naphthylmethylindole family.

101593060.name: Aurenin
101593060.description: Aurenin is an antibiotic with the molecular formula C33H54O11.

135410916.name: SL-75102
135410916.description: Progabide acid, also known as SL-75.102, is a GABA receptor agonist and an active metabolite of the anticonvulsant drug progabide.

137700196.name: 3F-PVP
137700196.description: 3-Fluoro-α-Pyrrolidinovalerophenone is a recreational designer drug from the substituted cathinone family with stimulant effects, which first appeared on the illicit market in around 2018.

138114916.name: Cyclopentadienyliron dicarbonyl iodide
138114916.description: Cyclopentadienyliron dicarbonyl iodide is an organoiron compound with the formula Fe 2I.

156487652.name: Camonsertib
156487652.description: Camonsertib is an investigational new drug that is being evaluated for the treatment of cancer.

163757284.name: 6-MBPB
163757284.description: 6-MBPB, also known as 6- benzofuran , is a monoamine releasing agent and entactogen-like drug of the amphetamine, phenylisobutylamine, and benzofuran families.

165360100.name: Testosterone furoate
165360100.description: Testosterone furoate , also referred to as testosterone furanate in some publications, is an androgen and anabolic steroid and a testosterone ester which is no longer marketed.

167312356.name: Cagrilintide
167312356.description: Cagrilintide is a long-acting analogue of amylin. It is being tested to treat obesity and type 2 diabetes by itself and in combination with semaglutide as cagrilintide/semaglutide .

172915172.name: 5-MeO-T-NB3OMe
172915172.description: 5-MeO-T-NB3OMe, or 5MT-NB3OMe, also known as N- -5-methoxytryptamine, is a serotonin receptor modulator and psychedelic drug of the tryptamine, 5-methoxytryptamine, and N-benzyltryptamine families...

175794276.name: 11-Methoxyasimilobine
175794276.description: 11-Methoxyasimilobine, also known as 1,11-dimethoxy-2-hydroxynoraporphine, is a serotonin 5-HT2 receptor agonist of the noraporphine family related to the noraporphine alkaloid asimilobine.

900000228.name: BI 1358894
900000228.description: BI 1358894 is an investigational antidepressant that works as a transient receptor potential cation channel inhibitor.

900000612.name: Diethylbenzenes
900000612.description: Diethylbenzene is any of three isomers with the formula C6H4 2.

900000740.name: Ertumaxomab
900000740.description: Ertumaxomab is a rat-murine hybrid monoclonal antibody designed to treat some types of cancer.

900000996.name: Imlifidase
900000996.description: Imlifidase, brand name Idefirix, is a medication for the desensitization of highly sensitized adults needing kidney transplantation, but unlikely to receive a compatible transplant.

900001252.name: Menotropin
900001252.description: Menotropin (also called human menopausal gonadotropin or hMG) is a hormonally active medication for the treatment of fertility disturbances.

900001380.name: Nivolumab
900001380.description: Nivolumab, sold under the brand name Opdivo, is an anti-cancer medication in the class of immune checkpoint inhibitors.

900001508.name: Pegzilarginase
900001508.description: Pegzilarginase, sold under the brand name Loargys, is a medication used for the treatment of hyperargininemia.

900001764.name: Ramucirumab
900001764.description: Ramucirumab , sold under the brand name Cyramza, is a fully human monoclonal antibody used for the treatment of cancer.

900002020.name: Tetraiodine nonoxide
900002020.description: Tetraiodine nonoxide is an iodine oxide with the chemical formula I4O9.

900002148.name: Vepalimomab
900002148.description: Vepalimomab is an experimental mouse monoclonal antibody intended for the treatment of inflammations. It blocks vascular adhesion protein 1. Development of the drug was discontinued in 2002.
